The technological advancements for this are going to be amazing. I'm very interested in what kind of society will be built when it's founded/built by scientists and engineers.

Personally I'd rather live in a traveling ship than a hostile planet. I'm curious to see how the EM drive develops.

Musk has already talked quite a bit about his visions for the society. He's envisioning a direct democracy with strict controls on the creation of new laws like never before. In particular a law could be created only by a super-majority of support, but it could be overturned by a minority vote. Laws would also automatically expire after a certain number of years and would have to be put up for vote again to stay on the books. Laws would also have to be short - less than 1000 words. The reason being that if it's longer than that we end up in the situation we currently have where congressmen pass laws that not one of them has fully read.

Economics is an interesting question but I think we can't even reasonably speculate there. We're entering into an era of automation that's going to be unlike anything this world has ever experienced. It stands to completely revolutionize the mass employment (or slavery) systems that we've used since the beginning of modern civilization.
